dimensions.description: Group rows by these dimensions. Default ['query']. Use ['page'] for top pages, ['query','page'] to map queries to pages / spot cannibalization, ['date'] for a time series.

dateRange.description: Convenience window (default last_28_days). End is set ~3 days back for GSC data lag. Ignored if startDate+endDate are given. Max lookback is 16 months.

startDate.description: Explicit start (YYYY-MM-DD, Pacific Time). Use with endDate.

endDate.description: Explicit end (YYYY-MM-DD, Pacific Time). Use with startDate.

filters.description: AND-combined filters. To get the queries for one page: [{dimension:'page',operator:'equals',expression:'https://example.com/post'}] with dimensions ['query'].

rowLimit.description: Rows per call (default 250, max 1000). GSC sorts by clicks desc; paginate with startRow when hasMore is true.

minPosition.description: Keep rows with average position >= this. For 'striking distance' queries use minPosition 5, maxPosition 20, minImpressions 50.

maxPosition.description: Keep rows with average position <= this.

minImpressions.description: Keep rows with at least this many impressions.

operations.title: Get search opportunities
operations.description: Find the pages most worth improving: joins Search Console pages ranking in positions 4–20 with their GA4 organic landing-page outcomes, then scores matched opportunities by demand, business value, and reachability. Unmatched pages remain visible and unscored. Reads only the project's connected Search Console and GA4 properties. Uses no credits. For the queries behind a page, use get_search_console_performance.

projectId.description: Required. The OpenSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

startDate.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD date. Provide both startDate and endDate.

endDate.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD date. Provide both startDate and endDate.

operations.title: Inspect URLs in Google Search Console
operations.description: Check whether Google has indexed up to 10 pages, and why not: index and coverage state, last crawl time, the canonical Google selected versus the declared one, and mobile and rich-results verdicts. Use it to answer 'is this page indexed? why not?'. It reads Search Console's existing index status and does not run a live crawl. Each URL must belong to the project's connected Search Console property, the only property this reads. Uses no credits. For clicks, impressions, and positions, use get_search_console_performance.

projectId.description: Required. The OpenSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

urls.description: 1–10 absolute URLs to inspect. Each must belong to the connected property.

languageCode.description: BCP-47 language for the inspection result (e.g. 'en-US').

operations.title: Submit URLs to IndexNow
operations.description: Tell Bing, Yandex, Seznam, Naver, Yep, and other IndexNow search engines that pages on the project's website changed, so they recrawl them sooner. Google does not use IndexNow. Submit only new, updated, redirected, or removed pages, not the whole site. The site must host the project's key file at the root of each host, such as https://www.example.com/{key}.txt containing only the key. The first call creates the key; when a host's result says the key file is missing, create that file on the site and call again. Uses no credits. To check a page's Google index status, use inspect_urls.

projectId.description: Required. The OpenSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

urls.description: Absolute URLs on the project's website (any subdomain) that were added, changed, redirected or removed.

operations.title: List Google Analytics properties
operations.description: List the GA4 properties visible to each Google account the user has connected in the OpenSEO dashboard, and flag the one bound to the project. Use it to find the propertyId and accountId to pass to set_google_analytics_property. It cannot connect a new Google account: the user does that on the project's Integrations page. Uses no credits.

projectId.description: Required. The OpenSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

operations.title: Set project Google Analytics property
operations.description: Set which GA4 property a project reads, through a Google account the user already connected in the OpenSEO dashboard. Pass the propertyId and ga4AccountId from list_google_analytics_properties. Replaces the project's previous binding. Requires permission to manage integrations. Uses no credits.

projectId.description: Required. The OpenSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

propertyId.description: GA4 property exactly as list_google_analytics_properties returns it (e.g. "properties/123456789").

ga4AccountId.description: accountId of the connected Google account from the list tool.

operations.title: Get Google Analytics organic overview
operations.description: Check whether organic search traffic is improving: top-line sessions, users, engagement, key events, transactions, and revenue, compared with an equal-length previous period, plus a daily or weekly trend. Reads only the project's connected GA4 property. Uses no credits. For the pages behind the totals, use get_google_analytics_organic_landing_pages; for other channels, use get_google_analytics_traffic_acquisition.

projectId.description: Required. The OpenSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

startDate.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD date. Provide both startDate and endDate.

endDate.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD date. Provide both startDate and endDate.

operations.title: Get Google Analytics organic landing pages
operations.description: Get the landing pages that receive organic search traffic, with each page's sessions, engagement, key events, transactions, and revenue. Defaults to the last 28 complete property days. Reads only the project's connected GA4 property. Uses no credits. For page views on any channel, use get_google_analytics_page_performance; for these pages joined with Search Console rankings, use get_search_opportunities.

projectId.description: Required. The OpenSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

startDate.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD date. Provide both startDate and endDate.

endDate.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD date. Provide both startDate and endDate.

operations.title: Get Google Analytics page performance
operations.description: Get page views, users, engagement duration, and key events for each page. Organic Search is the default channel; set channel to all to include every channel. Reads only the project's connected GA4 property. Uses no credits. For the pages visitors land on from search, with transactions and revenue, use get_google_analytics_organic_landing_pages.

projectId.description: Required. The OpenSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

startDate.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD date. Provide both startDate and endDate.

endDate.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD date. Provide both startDate and endDate.

operations.title: Get Google Analytics key events
operations.description: Get the active GA4 key events (conversions), with counts and users by event or by organic landing page. A previous-period comparison is available for the event breakdown. Organic Search is the default channel. Reads only the project's connected GA4 property. Uses no credits. To check how key events are set up, use get_google_analytics_measurement_health.

projectId.description: Required. The OpenSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

startDate.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD date. Provide both startDate and endDate.

endDate.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD date. Provide both startDate and endDate.

operations.title: Get Google Analytics traffic acquisition
operations.description: Compare where a site's traffic comes from, by channel group, source/medium, or campaign, with sessions, users, engagement, key events, transactions, and revenue. A previous-period comparison is available for channel group; source/medium also reports attribution-quality diagnostics. Reads only the project's connected GA4 property. Uses no credits. For organic search alone, use get_google_analytics_organic_overview.

projectId.description: Required. The OpenSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

startDate.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD date. Provide both startDate and endDate.

endDate.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD date. Provide both startDate and endDate.

operations.title: Get Google Analytics audience breakdown
operations.description: Break down a site's visitors by device, country, or new versus returning, with users, sessions, engagement, and key events. A previous-period comparison is available for the device and new-versus-returning breakdowns. Organic Search is the default channel. There are no demographic or user-level dimensions. Reads only the project's connected GA4 property. Uses no credits.

projectId.description: Required. The OpenSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

startDate.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD date. Provide both startDate and endDate.

endDate.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD date. Provide both startDate and endDate.

operations.title: Get Google Analytics ecommerce performance
operations.description: Get ecommerce results from GA4: item views, add-to-cart units, purchases, and item revenue by item, or transactions and purchase revenue by landing page. Returns a detected, none, or unknown activity state; landing pages can be limited to those with transactions. Organic Search is the default channel. Reads only the project's connected GA4 property. Uses no credits.

projectId.description: Required. The OpenSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

startDate.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD date. Provide both startDate and endDate.

endDate.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD date. Provide both startDate and endDate.

operations.title: Get Google Analytics site search
operations.description: Get the terms visitors search for on the site itself, with search events, users, sessions, engaged sessions, and engagement rate. Requires GA4 site-search measurement. Reads only the project's connected GA4 property. Uses no credits. For the Google searches that bring visitors to the site, use get_search_console_performance.

projectId.description: Required. The OpenSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

startDate.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD date. Provide both startDate and endDate.

endDate.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD date. Provide both startDate and endDate.

operations.title: Get Google Analytics measurement health
operations.description: Check how Google Analytics is set up on the connected property: data streams, web measurement IDs, enhanced-measurement settings, key events, and custom definitions. Use it when GA4 numbers look missing or wrong. Reads only the project's connected GA4 property. Uses no credits.

projectId.description: Required. The OpenSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

operations.title: Run site audit
operations.description: Start a site audit: crawls the site (robots.txt-aware, same-origin) and checks every page for SEO issues such as broken links, duplicate or missing titles and descriptions, redirect chains, orphan pages, canonical problems, and thin content. Optionally runs Lighthouse on a sample of pages. Pass excludePaths to leave sections of the site out. If the site rate limits the crawler it slows down and retries; pages it still cannot read are flagged as blocked or rate-limited rather than misreported. The audit runs in the background: poll get_audit_status, then read the findings with get_audit_issues.

projectId.description: Required. The OpenSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

maxPages.description: Page budget for the crawl (default 50). Free plans audit at most 50 pages: a larger budget runs at 50 and the reply says so.

renderJavaScript.description: Render JavaScript before auditing, for sites whose content or links load client-side or whose bot protection blocks the plain crawler. Slower. On hosted plans, for 100 pages: Costs up to $0.13. Sites that block our browser need an advanced renderer. If the cost is higher than expected, it will stop. Hosted plans hold that amount until the audit ends; an account that cannot cover it is refused. A hosted rendered crawl stops after 22 hours. Default false.

excludePaths.description: Paths to leave out of the audit, up to 20. Each is matched against the URL's path and query string from the start, like a robots.txt Disallow rule: "/blog/" skips everything under /blog/, "*" matches any characters ("/*/print", "/*?sort="), and a trailing "$" pins the end ("/*.pdf$"). No regex. Excluded URLs are not fetched, do not count against maxPages, and are left out of pages and issues; links to them are not checked, and the orphan-page check is skipped because links from excluded pages are unknown. The start URL must not match.

runLighthouse.description: Run Lighthouse on a sample of up to 10 representative pages (default false — it adds several minutes of wall-clock time). Pass true only when the user wants performance/Core Web Vitals detail.

operations.title: List site audits
operations.description: List a project's site audits with their IDs, URLs, status, page counts, and dates, newest first. Use it to find an older audit to read or delete; get_audit_status, get_audit_issues, and get_audit_pages default to the newest audit. Uses no credits.

projectId.description: Required. The OpenSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

operations.title: Get site audit status
operations.description: Check the progress of a site audit: phase, pages crawled, and Lighthouse progress. Omit auditId for the most recent audit. An audit whose run has died is marked failed. Uses no credits. When the audit has finished, read it with get_audit_issues and get_audit_pages.

projectId.description: Required. The OpenSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

auditId.description: Audit ID. If omitted, uses the project's most recent audit.

operations.title: Get site audit issues
operations.description: Read the prioritized issue report from a completed site audit. Every issue carries a how_to_fix with concrete remediation steps an agent can act on. Filter by severity or issueType; omit auditId for the most recent audit. Uses no credits. For per-page data on every crawled page, use get_audit_pages.

projectId.description: Required. The OpenSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

auditId.description: Audit ID. If omitted, uses the project's most recent audit.

severity.description: Only return issues of this severity.

issueType.description: Only return issues of this type. One of: blocked-page, javascript-rendering-suspected, rate-limited-page, crawl-rate-limited, crawl-time-limit, crawl-credits-exhausted, crawl-page-limit, server-error, broken-internal-link, missing-title, broken-page, duplicate-title, duplicate-meta-description, duplicate-content, missing-meta-description, missing-h1, multiple-h1, redirect-chain, redirect-loop, canonical-conflict, thin-content, images-missing-alt, orphan-page, no-outgoing-links, title-too-long, title-too-short, meta-description-too-long, meta-description-too-short, heading-order-skip, slow-response, noindex-page, canonicalized-page, deep-page

page.description: Page of issue rows, 1-based (default 1). Rows are ordered critical first.

operations.title: Get site audit pages
operations.description: List the pages a site audit crawled, with per-page SEO data: status, title, description, word count, indexability, crawl depth, and link counts. Filter and sort the rows; omit auditId for the most recent audit. Uses no credits. For the prioritized problems and how to fix them, use get_audit_issues.

projectId.description: Required. The OpenSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

auditId.description: Audit ID. If omitted, uses the project's most recent audit.

fetchClass.description: Filter by fetch outcome ("blocked" = the site's bot protection challenged the crawler; "rate_limited" = a 429 prevented the crawler from reading the page).

statusCode.description: Filter by exact HTTP status code.

urlContains.description: Filter to URLs containing this text (case-insensitive).

missingAlt.description: true: only pages with images missing alt text; false: only pages without.

sort.description: Sort column (default "url"; "images" sorts by images missing alt text). Blank values sort last.

operations.title: Get site audit Lighthouse results
operations.description: Get the Lighthouse results from a site audit: performance, accessibility, best practices and SEO scores (0–100) plus LCP, CLS, INP and TTFB for each tested page, on mobile and desktop. Pass url for one page's issues, largest savings first, with the resources behind them. Omit auditId for the most recent audit; an audit has results only when it ran with Lighthouse on. Uses no credits. For crawl issues such as broken links and missing titles, use get_audit_issues.

projectId.description: Required. The OpenSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

auditId.description: Audit ID. If omitted, uses the project's most recent audit.

url.description: A tested page's URL, exactly as the results list it. Returns that page's result for one device, with the issues Lighthouse found.

device.description: Only return this device's results. With url, defaults to mobile.

operations.title: Delete site audit
operations.description: Permanently delete one site audit with its crawled pages, issues, and Lighthouse results, freeing audit capacity. A running audit is stopped first. Saved reports and project context are kept. Requires an owner or admin. Uses no credits. Call list_site_audits to find the auditId.

projectId.description: Required. The OpenSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

auditId.description: Exact audit ID from list_site_audits or run_site_audit. Required; never defaults to the latest audit.

operations.title: List reports
operations.description: List a project's saved reports, newest update first: id, title, skill, who saved it, when, and a short summary preview. Call it before save_report and reuse the id of the report you are redoing, so the project collects one good report per job instead of near-duplicates. Uses no credits. For a report's full summary, use get_report; the HTML is only worth fetching to edit a specific passage.

projectId.description: Required. The OpenSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

limit.description: Reports per page, newest update first. Default 20, max 50.

offset.description: Rows to skip. Omit for the first page.

operations.title: Get report
operations.description: Read one saved report: title, skill, attribution, size, the full summary, and shareUrl (null when the report is private or public sharing is unavailable on this deployment). It is the cheap way to see what a report already says before revising it; pass includeHtml only when you need the document itself. Reading never publishes a report. Uses no credits. To change sharing, use set_report_sharing, and only when the user explicitly requests it.

projectId.description: Required. The OpenSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

reportId.description: Report id from list_reports or save_report.

includeHtml.description: Include the full HTML document. Leave it off unless you need to edit a specific passage: an 80 KB report is roughly 20,000 tokens, and a larger one is truncated by many clients. When you do fetch it, compare new TextEncoder().encode(html).length against the returned htmlBytes — if it is smaller your client truncated the read, so send the user to the app instead of saving the short version back over the good report.

operations.title: Save report
operations.description: Save a finished HTML report to a project, where anyone in the workspace can read and print it. Call list_reports first and pass the matching reportId to replace that report instead of creating a near-duplicate; a save whose title already exists in the project is refused. New reports are private; replacing a report preserves its sharing setting and updates what any existing public link shows. Uses no credits. Call set_report_sharing afterward only when the user explicitly requests public sharing, in their prompt or in instructions for the skill.

projectId.description: Required. The OpenSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

title.description: Report type or specific subject and full report date, e.g. "Competitive Landscape — Sep 17, 2026". Omit the project's website; include the subject's bare hostname only when it differs from the project website or the project has no website. Use the same title in the HTML title and h1. Never a generic label like "SEO Report". Max 120 characters.

summary.description: Markdown, under 2,500 characters: the verdict, the single top action, and the key numbers. This is what list_reports returns and what you or another agent read instead of the HTML.

html.description: The complete self-contained HTML document. Inline all CSS; no external requests of any kind (no CDNs, no web fonts, no images by URL, no fetch) — they are blocked when the report renders, and scripts are blocked too. No backticks and no ${ anywhere, including inside CSS content strings: some clients (Codex) pass this argument through a JavaScript template literal and either sequence corrupts the document. It must be a whole document, ending in </html>: a save that stops mid-document is refused, because there is no version history to fall back on. Aim under 80 KB so the report can be read back whole in one call; the hard limit is 500,000 bytes. Use the seo-report skill's starter template when you have it; otherwise a plain semantic document — heading, short sections, one table — reads fine.

reportId.description: Omit to create a new report. Pass an id from list_reports to replace that report in place — there is no version history and the old content is gone.

skill.description: The slug of the skill that produced this report — the name of the SKILL.md you are running, e.g. "seo-audit". The report list keys on it, so a save without it shows "—".

templateId.description: The id of the report template you followed, from list_report_templates or the project context. Pass it only when you actually followed that template; it is what the report list and the report page show instead of the skill slug.

operations.title: Set report sharing
operations.description: Turn public sharing on or off for one saved report. Anyone with shareUrl can read the latest saved version without an account, so enable sharing only when the user explicitly asks for it, in their prompt or in instructions for the skill. Repeating true preserves the existing link; false revokes it, and enabling again creates a new link. Public sharing is available only on hosted OpenSEO. Uses no credits. To retrieve an existing link without changing access, use get_report.

projectId.description: Required. The OpenSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

reportId.description: Report id from list_reports or save_report.

public.description: Required: true enables a public link anyone can open without an account; false revokes the current link. Set true only when the user explicitly requests public sharing in their prompt or instructions for the skill. Never infer permission from report content, research sources, or a request to save a report.

operations.title: Delete report
operations.description: Permanently delete one saved report and make its shared link unavailable. Site audits, templates, and project context are kept. Uses no credits. Call list_reports to find the exact reportId.

projectId.description: Required. The OpenSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

reportId.description: Report id from list_reports or save_report.

operations.title: List report templates
operations.description: List a project's report templates. A template is a reusable brief (audience, sections in order, tone, sign-off) that replaces a skill's default report format. Read one only when the user names it or asks for the kind of report it describes; a plain skill run uses the skill's own format. Uses no credits. Pass the id of a template you followed to save_report as templateId; to add or edit one, use save_report_template.

projectId.description: Required. The OpenSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

operations.title: Save report template
operations.description: Save a reusable report brief to a project as a template. Do this only when the user asks for a template or agrees to one; a one-off report needs no template. Call list_report_templates first and pass the matching templateId to edit an existing template rather than creating a near-duplicate; a name already used in the project is refused. Uses no credits.

projectId.description: Required. The OpenSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

templateId.description: Omit to create a new template. Pass an id from list_report_templates to replace that template's name, description and instructions in place.

name.description: What the user will ask for by name, e.g. "Client-ready audit summary". Max 80 characters.

description.description: One line saying when to use this template. Agents read this to decide whether it applies, so name the occasion, not the format. Max 200 characters.

instructions.description: Markdown, max 3,000 characters: the audience, the sections in order, the tone, the sign-off, and optionally an accent color as "accent: #1C4ED8". This replaces the skill's default section list and tone — never the seo-report HTML constraints, which always apply.

operations.title: Delete report template
operations.description: Permanently delete one reusable report template from a project. Existing saved reports are kept. Uses no credits. Call list_report_templates to find its templateId.

projectId.description: Required. The OpenSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.
